caption: The glowing embers in a fireplace are poked with a poker, and they brighten and send up a swirl of sparks.

sa.check: Glowing embers lie in a fireplace.
The embers brighten where they are disturbed.
The poke comes first and the brightening follows.

pc.expect: The embers brighten where the poker disturbs them and sparks rise from that spot.
pc.fail: The embers brighten before the poker reaches them; or the poker stirs the embers and nothing brightens or lifts; or the embers brighten at the far side of the grate from the poker; or sparks rise from a part of the grate the poker never touched.

pc.expect: The sparks rise with the hot air, drift and go dark, while the embers stay down in the grate.
pc.fail: The sparks fall to the hearth and lie there glowing; or sink below the grate; or an ember lifts and hangs in the air; or the sparks travel downward into the ash.

pc.expect: The brightening eases after the poking stops and the embers do not turn back into unburnt wood.
pc.fail: A glowing ember turns back into pale unburnt wood; or the glow keeps brightening after the poker is withdrawn; or the embers go dark and glow again with nothing touching them; or the ash gathers back into a whole log.

pc.expect: The embers are crumbling glowing lumps that break and shift under the poker and the ash is loose, while the poker stays rigid.
pc.fail: An ember bounces off the poker like a rubber ball; or the embers flow like a liquid; or the poker bends where it touches the embers; or the ash holds a rigid shape when pushed.

pc.expect: The embers in the grate are the embers that were there, breaking up rather than appearing or vanishing, and the poker stays outside them.
pc.fail: A glowing ember appears in the grate from nowhere; or an ember vanishes at a stroke while still bright; or the poker passes through the grate's floor; or a second poker appears.

pc.expect: The fireplace's surround, the grate and the hearth stay the same.
pc.fail: The surround changes colour; or the grate changes shape; or items on the hearth rearrange.

note: Who holds the poker is not judged.
